Record Class OpenOrderItem

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.leap.leaplaughlove.order.working.OpenOrderItem
Record Components:
orderId - the order
accountId - the account it was placed on
symbol - the instrument's symbol
side - BUY or SELL
quantity - whole shares ordered
status - OPEN, or the status a cancel just moved it to
orderType - LIMIT, STOP, STOP_LIMIT or TRAILING_STOP; MARKET for a market order queued for the open
limitPrice - the limit price, for LIMIT and STOP_LIMIT
stopPrice - the stop price, for STOP and STOP_LIMIT; a trailing stop's current stop
timeInForce - DAY or GTC
submittedAt - when it was placed
expiresAt - when it expires if it hasn't filled
triggeredAt - when a stop-limit's stop price was reached, so it now works as a limit
reservedCash - the cash a buy holds back from buying power, null for a sell
trailAmount - for a TRAILING_STOP, the dollars its stop trails the best price by
trailPercent - for a TRAILING_STOP, the percent its stop trails the best price by
trailPeak - for a TRAILING_STOP, the best price seen: the high for a sell, the low for a buy
parentOrderId - for a bracket's exit order, the buy whose fill opened it
ocoGroupId - for a bracket's exit order, the group its two legs share: one executes, the other is cancelled
bracketTakeProfitPrice - for a buy with a bracket, the take-profit price it will open at its fill
bracketStopLossPrice - for a buy with a bracket, the stop-loss price it will open at its fill
extendedHours - whether a LIMIT order may also fill in pre-market and after-hours
queued - whether this is a market order queued for the next open
collarPrice - for a queued market order, the most a buy pays or the least a sell takes
public record OpenOrderItem(UUID orderId, UUID accountId, String symbol, String side, long quantity, String status, String orderType, BigDecimal limitPrice, BigDecimal stopPrice, String timeInForce, OffsetDateTime submittedAt, OffsetDateTime expiresAt, OffsetDateTime triggeredAt, BigDecimal reservedCash, BigDecimal trailAmount, BigDecimal trailPercent, BigDecimal trailPeak, UUID parentOrderId, UUID ocoGroupId, BigDecimal bracketTakeProfitPrice, BigDecimal bracketStopLossPrice, boolean extendedHours, boolean queued, BigDecimal collarPrice) extends Record
An order waiting for the market to reach its price, as listed on the client's open orders.
